purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical receipt (shinryo-koui) processing system - prohibited drug combination check (kinki-yakuzai check) and editing logic for medical act entries
purpose.summary: This program (ORCSCKNKCHK) is a subprogram in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that performs prohibited drug combination checks and editing for medical treatment act entries. It checks drug interactions via the tbl_interact table and validates against a check master (tbl_chk), building SPA parameter areas for downstream processing. It handles both outpatient and inpatient scenarios.

notable_features: 16 COPY statements referencing ORCA-specific include files
MCP (Message Control Program) database access pattern (ORCA-specific)
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple SPA (Screen Parameter Area) parameters
OCCURS tables for drug combination check data (up to 100/30 entries)
EVALUATE for dispatch on function code (KBN)
PERFORM VARYING loops for drug interaction checking
verdict.notes: Source comments are in Japanese EUC encoding, decoded as latin-1 resulting in garbled characters. The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 58716 bytes total. Program is a called subprogram (EXIT PROGRAM) with USING clause parameters.
